source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all five Little China rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Public services and source-explicit procurement are separated from ruins, religious/community context and non-retail corporate presence. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only.

entities.name: Guānyīn Temple
entities.source_summary: Small Buddhist and folk-religious temple whose nuns provide prayer, advice and community succor; no paid customer-facing operation is established.

entities.name: Madame Lin’s Massage Parlor
entities.source_summary: Profitable massage business inherited and retrained by Freddy Lin; its current operation is genuine massage rather than the former front business.

entities.name: Hydrosubsidium
entities.source_summary: Corporate Little China presence whose source-explicit oceanographic survey work supports salvage and recovery operations in exchange for a share of recovered goods; no walk-in retail shelf is established.

entities.name: Ling Po Imports Wreckage
entities.source_summary: Vacant and guarded wreckage of the former Ling Po Imports premises, with clandestine excavation rumors but no active public commercial operation.

entities.name: Richard Night Aquarium
entities.source_summary: Hydrosubsidium-owned public aquarium reopened as both attraction and corporate showcase; visitors can use protected shuttle transport, and management may pay freelancers to acquire specimens for the collection.

services.label: Protected visitor shuttle from Upper Marina

purchase_policy.label: Freelance acquisition of aquarium specimens
purchase_policy.price_note: Management may pay freelancers; no fixed rate is stated.
